definitions.explanation: the inability to control the release of urine or feces

examples.japanese: {尿|にょう}{失禁|しっきん}に{悩|なや}む。
{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}の{失禁|しっきん}は{珍|めずら}しくない。
examples.english: Incontinence in elderly people is not uncommon.

examples.japanese: {失禁|しっきん}の{症状|しょうじょう}が{出|で}たら、{早|はや}めに{泌尿器科|ひにょうきか}を{受診|じゅしん}してください。
examples.english: If you develop incontinence symptoms, please see a urologist promptly.

notes:
A medical term for the involuntary loss of bladder or bowel control. Composed of {失|しつ} (to lose) + {禁|きん} (control, restraint).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {尿|にょう}{失禁|しっきん} — urinary incontinence
- {便|べん}{失禁|しっきん} — fecal incontinence
- {失禁|しっきん}{症|しょう} — incontinence (as a medical condition)
- {失禁|しっきん}パッド — incontinence pad

TYPES:
- {腹圧性|ふくあつせい}{尿|にょう}{失禁|しっきん} — stress urinary incontinence (triggered by coughing, sneezing, etc.)
- {切迫性|せっぱくせい}{尿|にょう}{失禁|しっきん} — urge incontinence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {夜尿症|やにょうしょう} — bedwetting, nocturnal enuresis (specifically during sleep)
- {漏|も}らす — to leak (colloquial way of describing the act itself)
